# gravitino_catalog Resource



## Example Usage

```hcl
resource "gravitino_catalog" "example" {
  # ... example configuration ...
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `metalake` (String) The metalake name.
- `name` (String) The catalog name.
- `type` (String) The catalog type. Must be one of: relational, fileset, messaging, model.

### Optional

- `catalog_provider` (String) The catalog provider. Must be one of: hive, lakehouse-iceberg, lakehouse-paimon, lakehouse-hudi, jdbc-mysql, jdbc-postgresql, jdbc-doris, jdbc-oceanbase, kafka, fileset, model.
- `comment` (String) A comment or description for the catalog.
- `properties` (Map of String) A map of key-value properties for the catalog.

### Read-Only

- `audit` (Object) Audit information for the catalog. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--audit))
- `id` (String) Composite identifier in the format 'metalake.catalog_name'.

<a id="nestedatt--audit"></a>
### Nested Schema for `audit`

Read-Only:

- `create_time` (String)
- `creator` (String)
